name: earthquake
title: Bay District Quake
severity: Magnitude ~6.4 aftershock cluster. Conflicting bridge status. Hospital power loss. Shelter oxygen shortfall.

reports.text: Main St Bridge structural failure detected. Both spans impassable. Debris field expanding.
Just drove over Main St Bridge — it's open, traffic is normal.
Bay Clinic lost grid power. Life support on limited UPS. Requesting portable generator. River Shelter needs medical oxygen ASAP.
